author: Bobby Grayson
description: Iterations were about Lean plumbing again: constructor field order in cases patterns, apply with rfl arguments unifying the wrong record, missing Nat. prefixes without Mathlib. None about the invariant, which the 236k-config check had validated.
title: The proof cost of the new layer was in two reusable lemmas, not in the cases: 20 of 22 cases are 'apply frame' or 'apply terminate_ne' with trivial side goals. Asynchronous signals made the terminate lemma a plain record computation
